# SYNESIS_E011 — Error

## Description

Qualified chain with incorrect structure: example_a -> example_b.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The structure of this chain is incorrect: `example_a -> example_b`
  Found:    example_a -> example_b
  Expected: [Concept] -> [RELATION] -> [Concept]
  In qualified chains, even positions are always relation types,
  not concepts. Review the order of the elements.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MalformedQualifiedChain**: `elements`
